title: Betterleaks v2 finding
description: One serialized report.Finding, nested in a JSONL finding envelope or in the findings array of a JSON scan report; versioning belongs to the enclosing report. Discovery supplies match and location; optional analysis describes credential state, identity, and permissions.

rule_hash.description: Hash of this rule and its required and optional component definitions, including provider expressions. Excludes global filters. Supplied by Scanner; may be absent on externally constructed findings.

confidence.description: Detection confidence, normally low, medium, high, or an empty string when unclassified. Custom source attributes can supply other strings; this field is intentionally not an enum.

attributes.description: Extensible source metadata such as resource, git.sha, or git.author_name. Path is promoted into location.path. fs.first_fragment is omitted; git.message is abbreviated to its first line with ... for further nonblank text.

analysis.description: Credential state and optional identity and permission evidence. Omitted when no provider result exists.

component_sets.description: Multipart credential combinations, each with its own status and severity. Full analysis is reported on the parent finding. Omitted when empty.

component_sets_truncated.description: True when the hard combination limit omitted possible credentials. Invalid attempted sets cannot establish an exhaustive invalid result.

encodings.description: Distinct encodings encountered during decoding (for example base64, percent, hex, unicode), not an ordered decoding sequence. Omitted when no decoding occurred.

decode_depth.description: Number of decoding passes. Omitted when no decoding occurred.

metadata.description: Provider-specific JSON data; values may include nested objects, arrays, scalars, or null.

location.description: Source-relative position. Text matches normally use one-based lines and byte columns; unavailable coordinates and paths are omitted. Message coordinates are message-relative.

path.description: Optional source-defined path, such as a file, Git object, or archive member.

status.description: Credential liveness result. An empty Go status is omitted; none is a CLI selector, not a serialized status.

reason.description: Explanation of permission enrichment, including incomplete evidence or failure.

severity.description: Provider-neutral lower bound derived by Betterleaks from positively observed capabilities. Independent of detection confidence and credential validity.

capabilities.description: Positively observed grants. An absent capability means unknown, not denied.

debug.description: Optional sanitized provider diagnostics, grouped by validation and analysis Expr stage.

status_reason.description: Explanation of the credential state or incomplete validation.

status_metadata.description: Explicit public metadata produced by validation, independent of enrichment metadata.

identity.description: Available identity of the principal associated with the credential. Fields may be omitted independently.

account.description: One unambiguous account or tenant reached by the credential. Omitted when analysis cannot identify a single account.

componentAnalysis.description: Compact outcome for one credential combination. Omitted when status and severity are both empty.

components.description: One credential combination. Normally an array of component findings; nil SDK slices and pointers serialize as null.

rule_hash.description: Hash of this rule and its required and optional component definitions, including provider expressions. Excludes global filters. Supplied by Scanner; may be absent on externally constructed findings.

optional.description: Whether this component is optional in the primary rule. Omitted when false.

encodings.description: Distinct encodings encountered during decoding (for example base64, percent, hex, unicode), not an ordered decoding sequence. Omitted when no decoding occurred.

decode_depth.description: Number of decoding passes. Omitted when no decoding occurred.

full.description: Matched text, or a description for a path-only rule. May be redacted.

value.description: Extracted value. May be a non-secret component, empty for path-only findings, or redacted.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the original match.value bytes as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters without a prefix, using the .betterleaksignore format. The value may be a secret or a non-secret component, such as an account ID. Preserved through redaction and analysis. Supplied by Scanner for non-empty primary and component values; may be absent on externally constructed matches.

captures.description: Named regex captures from this match.

context.description: Explicitly requested source window around the match, omitted when empty. It does not default to the source line.
